== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (Japanese)|Infantry Mine (Dark)]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944015/ggv0wbFn6UCig1t3blESKA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099886.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>36a636aa92029209866a592dd1a54821bdb8ac0d7f816427176c6915488224ee</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
